title: 第23章 玄玉参第24章 师妹被欺负速来
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
第23章玄玉参云洛感觉自己好像进了滚筒洗衣机，转得不知天地为何物。
不知过去多久，她被甩飞在地面，眼冒金星。
“玉e……”
云洛吐得稀里哗啦，晕头转向撑着玄铁剑起身。
她开始打量自己身处的位置，发现这是一片沼泽地。
时不时有奇形怪状的妖兽从沼泽潭里探出来。
都是没有妖丹的妖兽，杀了也没什么用。
云洛没有理会，拿出玉简联系秦慕霜。
“小师妹，你在哪儿？”
秦慕霜几乎是瞬间接通，云洛拿着玉简转了一圈，让她看到自己所处的环境。
“我知道了，沼泽地很危险，你站着别动，我马上来找你。”
云洛将玄铁剑横在身前，警惕注意着周围变化。
一刻钟后，秦慕霜御剑而来。
“师姐，时间紧，我们先完成宗门的任务吧。”
宗门下发的任务主要是搜集秘境里的天材地宝。
只要搜集够了，多出的东西都是自己的。
云洛知道大师姐是特意照顾她，也不想拖累她找机缘。
秦慕霜作为带队弟子，刚才来的路上已经根据每个人的落点位置进行了组队和任务分配。
“我俩一队，任务难一点，是去采集玄阶五色莲和龙涎草。”
这两种灵植都可以净化灵力，提升丹药品质。

不过玄阶灵植的周围一般会有金丹妖兽存在。
“没问题，师姐，我们现在就行动吧。”
秦慕霜召唤出灵剑，二人站上去，根据地图指引的方向前进。
归墟秘境很大，许多灵植不止在一处生长。
飞了约一个时辰，秦慕霜在一处悬崖停下。
这里是龙涎草的生长点。
或许是她们来得早，悬崖边还没有其他人。
秦慕霜握紧灵剑：“师妹，一会儿我来引开妖兽，你去摘龙涎草。”
“好，师姐小心。”
悬崖边长满了密密麻麻的龙涎草，但不到十分之一才有品阶，能达到玄阶的不足百分之一。
秦慕霜飞身靠近一棵长势最好的龙涎草，果然在要触碰到时一只野猪大的蝎子横空跳出。
这蝎子周身萦绕着紫色烟雾，尾巴长长的倒钩呈现出金属光泽。
秦慕霜松了口气，蝎子有毒，但幸而只有金丹初期。
content_en:
Chapter 23 Xuanyu Shen Yunluo felt like he had entered a drum washing machine, spinning so fast that he didn’t know what the world was.
I don't know how much time passed, but she was thrown to the ground, with stars in her eyes.
"Jade..."
Yunluo vomited loudly and stood up, dizzy, holding on to the Black Iron Sword.
She began to look at where she was and realized it was a swamp.
From time to time, strange monsters emerge from the swamp.
They are all monsters without demon elixirs, so killing them is of no use.
Yunluo ignored it and took out the jade slip to contact Qin Mushuang.
"Little junior sister, where are you?"
Qin Mushuang connected almost instantly, and Yunluo took the jade slip and turned it around to let her see the environment she was in.
"I understand. The swamp is very dangerous. Just stay still and I will come to you right away."
Yun Luo held the Black Iron Sword horizontally in front of him, alertly paying attention to the changes around him.
A quarter of an hour later, Qin Muchang came with a sword.
"Senior sister, time is tight, let's complete the sect's mission first."
The main task assigned by the sect is to collect heavenly materials and earthly treasures in the secret realm.
As long as you collect enough, anything extra is yours.
Yunluo knew that the senior sister was specially taking care of her, and he didn't want to hinder her in finding opportunities.
As the leading disciple, Qin Mushuang had already organized team formation and task assignments based on everyone's location on the way here.
"The two of us are in a team. The task is a bit more difficult. We are going to collect Xuanjie five-color lotus and ambergris."
Both of these spiritual plants can purify spiritual power and improve the quality of elixirs.
However, there are usually golden elixir monsters around Xuan-level spiritual plants.
"No problem, senior sister, let's take action now."
Qin Mushuang summoned the spirit sword, and the two of them stood on it and moved forward according to the direction guided by the map.
The secret realm of Guixu is very large, and many spiritual plants grow in more than one place.
After flying for about an hour, Qin Mushuang stopped at a cliff.
This is where ambergris grows.
Perhaps they arrived early and there was no one else on the cliff yet.
Qin Mushuang clenched her spirit sword: "Junior sister, I will lure the monster away later, and you go pick ambergris."
"Okay, senior sister, be careful."
The edge of the cliff is covered with dense ambergris, but less than one-tenth can reach the grade level, and less than one percent can reach the xuan level.
Qin Mushuang flew close to the best-growing ambergris, and sure enough, when he was about to touch it, a scorpion as big as a wild boar jumped out of the air.
Purple smoke lingered around the scorpion, and the long barbs of its tail showed a metallic sheen.
Qin Mushuang breathed a sigh of relief. Scorpions are poisonous, but fortunately they only have the early stage of the golden elixir.
